new_human_diagnosis.summary: Dialogue remains mechanically turn-based because speech often floats without enough expression, physical behavior, perception, listener reaction, environmental interruption, or scene-state change carrying meaning. The problem is not merely short lines; it is dialogue functioning as isolated information exchange rather than part of continuous lived narration.
new_human_diagnosis.important_constraint: Do not respond by mechanically adding generic gesture tags such as looking, frowning, sighing, clenching fists, or pausing after every line. Actions/reactions must alter meaning, pressure, relationship, timing, inference, or choice.

scale_authorization.reason: CAL-02 remains rejected and CAL-03 remains mechanically unsatisfactory; one preferred local direction is insufficient to define the whole manuscript surface.

next: Run Phase363 Round2 embodied-dialogue calibration using CAL-01-A as a positive anchor, rebuild CAL-02 and CAL-03, and explicitly test continuous narration/action/perception around speech before any full rewrite.
